name: Omni Tucson National Resort & Spa
insider_take: Desert luxury meets championship golf at this sprawling Sonoran sanctuary where mountain sunsets paint the sky in brilliant oranges and purples.
whats_special: This resort sits on 650 acres in the stunning Sonoran Desert foothills, featuring two championship golf courses including the Catalina Course that hosts PGA Tour events. The property boasts dramatic views of the Catalina Mountains and unique desert wildlife like roadrunners and coyotes roaming the grounds.
pro_tip: Book a casita room on the golf course side for unobstructed mountain views and watch for the famous Tucson sunsets from your private patio – they're considered among the most spectacular in the Southwest.
dont_miss: The resort's signature spa treatments using indigenous desert botanicals like prickly pear and jojoba, and the legendary "19th Hole" restaurant where you can spot javelinas (wild pigs) wandering the golf course while dining on Southwestern cuisine.
pros: World-class championship golf with 36 holes set against stunning Sonoran Desert scenery
Full-service spa offering rejuvenating treatments inspired by Native American traditions
Spacious resort-style accommodations with private patios and breathtaking desert views
Multiple dining options showcasing fresh Southwestern cuisine and local flavors
Expansive outdoor pool complex perfect for relaxing under the Arizona sun
cons: Secluded location requires a car for access to downtown Tucson attractions
Resort and golf fees may add significantly to the overall cost of stay
